on-accent-ink.displayName: White Ink on Flat Red, large text only

display.purpose: The subpage <h1> or home hero statement. One per page.

headline.purpose: Section headline (.head-title), the home credits' names and the FAQ categories: --fs-h2 clamp(2.25rem, min(6vw, 9svh), 5.5rem). Always under the home hero, always over a list row: hero > h2 > row > row-sm at every viewport.

title.purpose: Row title in a long list: sessions, FAQ questions, clippings, the speaker register.

label.purpose: Mono section label, uppercase by CSS, 0.2em tracking (mono grid 0.1/0.15/0.2em, floored at 0.1em). Also the numbered eyebrow (.eyebrow-index) that heads every home section, and the footer folio.

label-lg.purpose: Nav, ghost buttons, email links, hairline links. 0.2em tracking.

label-xs.purpose: Micro mono (avatar counts, kit tags, portrait captions). 0.6875rem = 11px, the mono floor: no mono label sets smaller.

cta.purpose: The label on a red button (cta-label): JetBrains Mono Bold 700 at --fs-cta 1.17rem (18.7px), white, 0.12em, uppercase. White on #F11000 is 4.36:1, AA only as large text (>=18.66px bold), so never shrink it.

shadows.name: print-mount
shadows.purpose: A photograph is mounted, not floated: keyline plus shadow.

motion.name: control
motion.purpose: The standard control transition: buttons, inputs, links.

motion.name: cover
motion.purpose: The header mark and Tickets fading out while the home hero covers them.

motion.name: field
motion.purpose: The row reach field colour and opacity fade.

motion.name: arrive
motion.purpose: The house arrive curve: sheet entry, row pull.

motion.name: develop
motion.purpose: The signature motion: a B&W photograph develops to colour on hover (the home frame, the venue route photos) and the one speaker print beside the /speakers register and the home credits via [data-developed], while a row of its list is hovered or focused. With the portrait view transition, the only decorative motion. No page entry, no scroll reveal.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action a section wants. Large on purpose: at poster scale a small CTA reads as an afterthought. White JetBrains Mono Bold at --fs-cta (brand manual p. 11; AA as large text only, never shrink). Hover inverts the fill; no lift, no glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.7rem; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 1.17rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #FFFFFF; background: #F11000; border: 1px solid #F11000; border-radius: 2px; padding: 1.25rem 2.8rem; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FFFFFF; border-color: #FFFFFF; color: #000000; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F11000; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The secondary action. Transparent with the control-edge boundary; hover brightens the edge and widens the gap.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.84rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #FFFFFF; background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255,0.4); border-radius: 2px; padding: 1.25rem 2rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, gap 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { border-color: #FFFFFF; gap: 0.85rem; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F11000; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: A plain mono section label. No decoration, no trailing hairline, uppercased by CSS.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.55); margin: 0; }

components.name: Numbered Eyebrow
components.description:
The brand manual's "01 — THE CASE" as a section head (.eyebrow-index): the index in red with a faint em dash after it, the label muted, mono --fs-label at 0.2em, weight 400 so it serves as the

. Heads every home section (01 The event, 02 Tickets, 03 Speakers, 04 Partners, 05 Newsletter); the heading itself where the section has no poster head, a

above one otherwise. The index is the section's one small red mark.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow-index { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.75rem; margin: 0 0 clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.55); } .ds-eyebrow-no { color: #F11000; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-eyebrow-no::after { content: '\2014'; margin-left: 0.75rem; color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.5); }

components.name: Stamp
components.description: The manual's rubber stamp (p. 01, 09, 12): a 2px red outlined box at --radius, mono Bold --fs-label-sm caps at 0.2em, knocked -7deg off true, inline-block so a row keeps its rhythm without it. A state word only, for the one final ticket state ("Sold out"); never a label the layout depends on, never decoration. Red on black: 4.82:1.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-block; padding: 0.3em 0.7em; border: 2px solid #F11000; border-radius: 2px; color: #F11000; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.2; white-space: nowrap; transform: rotate(-7deg); transform-origin: center; }

components.name: Field Row (link)
components.description: The container language for every list: no rules, separation is air and type scale. A row that IS the control paints a full-bleed red reach field on hover and every ink goes full black.
components.html:
• 10:00 · Main hallAgents that ship: a field report01
  • 11:00 · Main hallGenerative UI without the hype02
components.css: .ds-field { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #000000; } .ds-field-row { position: relative; isolation: isolate; padding: 2rem 0; } .ds-row-link { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 0.6rem 2rem; align-items: end; color: #FFFFFF; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.28s ease; } .ds-row-link::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0 -2rem; background: #F11000; opacity: 0; z-index: -1; transition: opacity 0.28s ease; } .ds-row-link:hover::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-row-link:hover, .ds-row-link:hover * { color: #000000; } .ds-row-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F11000; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row-meta { grid-column: 1; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.74rem; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.55); } .ds-row-title { grid-column: 1; font-family: var(--font-bebas-neue, 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif); font-size: clamp(1.7rem, min(4vw, 6svh), 3.4rem); line-height: 1; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-row-figure { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1 / span 2; font-family: var(--font-bebas-neue, 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif); font-size: clamp(2.1rem, min(4.2vw, 6svh), 4rem); line-height: 0.9; color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.55); }

components.name: Lit Field
components.description: The text field: a 5.5% white plate with the control-edge boundary, turning accent-hot on focus. Keyboard focus adds the ring tight against the edge.
components.html: <label class="ds-lit-label">Company name<input class="ds-lit-field" type="text" placeholder="Acme Example s.r.o."></label>
components.css: .ds-lit-label { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.62); } .ds-lit-field { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.85rem 0.95rem; background: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.055); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255,0.4); border-radius: 2px; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: var(--font-special-elite, 'Special Elite', cursive); font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; } .ds-lit-field::placeholder { color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.5); } .ds-lit-field:focus { outline: none; border-color: #F11000; background: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.086); } .ds-lit-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F11000; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Credits
components.description: Home speakers teaser as a poster's billing block: the numbered eyebrow "03 Speakers" with a mono count on its baseline, then up to six names and nothing else (Bebas --fs-h2 in dim ink, the active one white; no roles, those live on /speakers), rows on 0.35rem of space, no rules. One 4:5 portrait in a fixed 420px column mirrors the active row (aria-hidden), overruns the content column by the gutter to the viewport edge, and develops to colour while a row is hovered or focused. A hairline "See all N speakers" link closes the list. No auto-rotation. Under 760px: no portrait, names at --fs-h3.
components.html:
• Jane Example
  • John Example
components.css: .ds-credits { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 420px; gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 5rem); align-items: start; background: #000000; } .ds-credits-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.35rem; min-width: 0; } .ds-credit { display: block; text-decoration: none; } .ds-credit-name { font-family: var(--font-bebas-neue, 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif); font-size: clamp(2.25rem, min(6vw, 9svh), 5.5rem); line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.6); } .ds-credit.is-active .ds-credit-name, .ds-credit:hover .ds-credit-name, .ds-credit:focus-visible .ds-credit-name { color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-credit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F11000; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-credit-plate { width: 420px; margin-right: calc(-1 * min(clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem), 6.25vw)); aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; background: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.04); filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.14) brightness(0.84); transition: filter 0.6s ease; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255,0.16), 0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-credits-list:hover ~ .ds-credit-plate, .ds-credits-list:focus-within ~ .ds-credit-plate { filter: grayscale(0) contrast(1.02) brightness(1); }

components.name: Speaker Register
components.description: The /speakers lineup as a register: one row per speaker and one portrait beside the list, no grid of prints. A row is a button: the name Bebas --fs-row-sm in dim ink, the role mono --fs-label-sm right-set on its baseline (one line, ellipsis, 42% of the row), 0.55rem of space between rows, no rules. The reached row (pointer or focus) goes white and puts its speaker on the shared 4:5 print in a fixed 420px column: sticky under the bar, overrunning the column by the gutter to the viewport edge, developing while a row is reached, carrying the view transition into the sheet. Under 900px: the register alone, role under the name. Hierarchy by ink on one size.
components.css: .ds-register { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 420px; gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 5rem); align-items: start; background: #000000; } .ds-register-list { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; } .ds-srow { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.25rem 2rem; width: 100%; margin: 0; padding: 0.55rem 0; text-align: left; font: inherit; color: inherit; background: transparent; border: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-srow:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F11000; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-sname { font-family: var(--font-bebas-neue, 'Bebas Neue', sans-serif); font-size: clamp(1.7rem, min(4vw, 6svh), 3.4rem); line-height: 0.9; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.6); overflow-wrap: anywhere; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-srole { font-family: var(--font-jetbrains-mono, 'JetBrains Mono', monospace); font-size: 0.74rem; letter-spacing: 0.15em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.55); text-align: right; max-width: 42%; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-srow.is-active .ds-sname, .ds-srow:focus-visible .ds-sname { color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-srow.is-active .ds-srole, .ds-srow:focus-visible .ds-srole { color: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.7); } .ds-sportrait { position: sticky; top: calc(4.5rem + 2rem); margin-right: calc(-1 * min(clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem), 6.25vw)); aspect-ratio: 4 / 5; background: rgba(255, 255, 255,0.04); filter: grayscale(1) contrast(1.14) brightness(0.84); transition: filter 0.6s ease; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255,0.16), 0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); } .ds-register-list:hover ~ .ds-sportrait, .ds-register-list:focus-within ~ .ds-sportrait { filter: grayscale(0) contrast(1.02) brightness(1); }

narrative.overview: A film-noir darkroom with one light: a single black ground, white ink, greys only as white at an opacity, and red spent as a detail, a CTA fill or the row reach field, never as running text and never as a ground. Headlines are poster-scale condensed caps, body copy is a typewriter face used as texture, labels are tracked mono. Depth comes from tonal panels, hairlines and a raking wash; nothing glows. Photographs rest in high-contrast B&W and develop to colour on hover. Lists carry no rules; the reach state marks an entry.
keyCharacteristics: One theme, and it is dark
Red is a detail, a CTA fill or a rule, never running text and never a ground; one red mark per list
Sections are numbered case-file eyebrows (01 — The event), not poster heads; the content is the headline
Lists, not cards: a talk is type on the sheet, a speaker is a row, the names are the credits
Three faces: Bebas Neue, Special Elite, JetBrains Mono (brand manual v1.0)
Lists without rules; the red reach field on hover
No glow: hover and live states are flat colour changes
No icon library; glyphs are text

rules.name: The Red Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Brand manual v1.0 (p. 08-09): three colours, #000000, #FFFFFF, #F11000; greys only as white or black at an opacity (panels, ink, washes are white rgba()). Red marks details (a dot, 1-2 headline words, the year, CTA words, the stamp, the index of a numbered eyebrow) and, as a large area, only primary CTA fills and the row reach field. No red ground: every closer, the /partners CTA and the newsletter sit on black. Red is a verb: one word, one button, one state per page. Never running text (inline prose links are white on the red hairline), never a wash, never another accent hue. One red mark per list (manual p. 11). Errors stay red: a state.

rules.name: The Size Not Dimming Rule
rules.body: On red, hierarchy comes from size. On flat #F11000 (chips, the reach field) ink is #000000 at full opacity (4.8:1); 85% black is for control boundaries only; white only for large type (4.36:1). A red button's label is white JetBrains Mono Bold at --fs-cta 1.17rem (cta-label), never smaller; where it does not fit, the control moves (header Tickets into the menu under 384px). Red type on black (the stamp, the eyebrow index) is 4.82:1 and sets Bold or at --fs-label and above.

rules.name: The Numbered Section Rule
rules.body: A home section is headed by .eyebrow-index, the manual's "01 — THE CASE": index in red, em dash faint, label muted, mono --fs-label at 0.2em, weight 400 so it can be the <h2>. The content under it is the headline (the waves, the names, the marks); only the newsletter sets a --fs-h2 title under its eyebrow. Section titles say what the section is. Subpages keep SubpageHero and .head-split.

rules.name: The Stamp Rule
rules.body: .stamp (a red 2px outlined box, mono Bold --fs-label-sm caps, rotated -7deg) marks one final state only: a sold-out ticket wave. It is never decoration, never a label the layout depends on, and never a second red mark in a list that already has one. Any other unavailable state is a .record-status word.

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: One --fs-display element per page. Sections run at --fs-h2.

rules.name: The One Red Word Rule
rules.body: The red accent word and the closing full stop belong to the home hero statement (and the invite title). Every subpage hero title carries neither; section heads and every Closer title are plain white.

rules.name: The No Fake Styles Rule
rules.body: font-synthesis: none. One weight per face (JetBrains Mono 400/500, and 700 only for the CTA label) and no italic, so prose emphasis is ink (strong steps up to --color-text). Czech letters Special Elite lacks fall to JetBrains Mono.

rules.name: The No Decorative Lines Rule
rules.body: A hairline only where it carries structure: the agenda grid, data tables, control boundaries (the press kit's format chips included), link underlines, progress spines, the cookie banner edge. No section dividers, no rule under a head or above the hero's footing line, no ruled readouts, no left-edge lines, no tiles or borders behind partner logos.

rules.name: The Motion Answers A Change Rule
rules.body: No scroll reveal, no per-section entrance, no page-entry animation: the hero lands still. One signature motion: a high-contrast B&W photograph (manual p. 13; gallery and avatars at contrast 1.3) develops to colour on hover (the home frame, the venue photos, the speaker print beside a reached list). Only the home hero's topic rotor (captioned "On the programme", shown on phones too) moves on its own; no ticker, no countdown, no marquee, no scroll strip; the agenda's live dot is static. Hover painting on rows only under (hover: hover).

rules.name: The Bebas Setting Rule
rules.body: Bebas sets uppercase at line-height 0.9-1.0 and tracking 0 (manual p. 10): --lh-display 0.9, --track-display 0, row-title() line-height 1. No Bebas rule carries its own letter-spacing.

rules.name: The Mono Grid Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono tracks at 0.1, 0.15 or 0.2em (manual p. 10); the CTA label's 0.12em is the one exception. mono() floors effective tracking at 0.1em under --track-scale. Speaker names in Agenda and Sessions are Special Elite lore, sentence case.

rules.name: The Logo Never Shrinks Rule
rules.body: Official files only (manual p. 03-07). The header logo is a fixed 190px box (180px digital minimum) with a max-content brand column; the bar tightens on phones and drops its Tickets button under 384px instead. No opacity change on logo hover, header or footer; nothing darkens the logo (the invite OG composites it after the vignette).

rules.name: The Recipe Rule
rules.body: Every font declaration goes through _type.scss (mono, cta-label, display, row-title, prose, hairline-link); every font-size through the ramp.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: No glow anywhere. Hover and live states are flat colour changes: an inverted fill for buttons, a border or ink change for rows and fields. The print mount stays: a photograph is mounted, not floated.

rules.name: The Size By Tier Rule
rules.body: Partner logos sit on the page ground with no tile, border or plate, each in its original colours (brand manual p. 15); dark-ink masters on a paper-white card. On /partners rank reads from size: opticalBox() gives each mark equal ink area within its tier's reference box (Platinum 600x300, Diamond 288x176, Gold/Silver 246x150, Media/Community 200x110) on a left-set grid whose column is the box width; a mark at ratio ≥6 spans two cells. Every tier heading is Bebas --fs-h3; on a phone every tier but Platinum sets two to a row at 0.8. The home wall is one wall of tier rows under the "04 Partners" eyebrow: the tier as a mono label in an 8rem margin column, the marks beside it on one cap height per tier (--mark-h 3.75 / 2.6 / 2.1rem), left-set and wrapping; Media stays on /partners.

rules.name: The End Line Rule
rules.body: A Closer, on the black ground, ends a page that asks for a decision (speakers, agenda, workshops, venue, invite). A page that asks for none ends on an EndLine (one lede line and one hairline link) or on its content (legal pages, 404's step list).

rules.name: The One Plate Per Route Rule
rules.body: The detective key art is the home hero's alone. A subpage about the event takes one documentary plate of its own (speakers: devfest-2025-03, partners: devfest-2025-01, agenda: the mill chimney, venue: the mill entrance tower), graded B&W; every other subpage, /team included, opens type-only (photo={false}). One photograph per page beyond that: the home frame under section 01, the venue route photos, the one speaker print beside a list.

rules.name: The Earned Noir Rule
rules.body: Noir wordplay is spent in a few earned places: the home hero statement, the 404 "Nothing filed under that", and at most one closer line per page ("Doors open 30 October.", "See you on the 30th."). Every section and page title says plainly what it is ("The event", "Tickets", "Speakers", "Partners", "Newsletter", "Agenda", "The team", "Questions", "Become a partner"). No triads, no em-dash chains, no hype words.

rules.name: The One Date Format Rule
rules.body: Event facts come from src/lib/event.ts: doors 08:00, keynote 09:00, close 19:00, afterparty to 23:00. "30 October 2026" in running copy, "30 Oct 2026" in stamps, never "October 30"; 24-hour HH:MM; British "programme".

dos: Do use global primitives by class name (.band, .eyebrow, .eyebrow-index, .stamp, .display, .field-row, .btn-primary, .btn-ghost).
Do head a home section with .eyebrow-index and let the content be the headline.
Do give every data-backed page a .fallback-note.
Do use --field-border (≥3:1) for any interactive control boundary.
Do add a prefers-reduced-motion opt-out to every animation.
Do use .hairline-link for every "see all" or next-step link.
Do head a list of next steps with NextStepList's mono label, an <ol> when the steps are a sequence.
Do render every partner mark through the partner-logo() recipe and its LogoMono mode.
donts: Don't add a fourth font, an icon package, Tailwind or CSS-in-JS.
Don't set paragraphs in #F11000, add a second red or any other accent hue, or use --color-error as an accent.
Don't add rules, boxes or opacity 'inactive' states to a list.
Don't paint the reach field on :focus; focus draws a ring.
Don't introduce a prefers-color-scheme block for a single component.
Don't use translateX on the red reach field; the pull belongs to the wash.
Don't stack a second poster headline under a hero that already names the band; give the band an sr-only h2.
Don't put a mood eyebrow ('Be there', 'Join us') on a closer; an eyebrow carries a fact or nothing.
Don't paint a red ground under a closer, a form or a section; the red on a screen is its button.
Don't use .stamp for anything but a final ticket state, and never as decoration.
Don't put a card, a panel or a box around a list entry (a talk, a speaker, an open FAQ answer); type on the sheet with a rule only where it carries structure.
Don't add a glow, a lift or a drop shadow to a hover or live state.
Don't draw a tile, border or plate behind a partner logo; size carries the tier.
Don't set a mono label under 11px (--fs-label-xs is the floor).
Don't typeset the DevFest.cz name as a second wordmark; use the official logo file.
Don't shrink, dim or overlay the logo; change the layout instead.
Don't set a label on red smaller than --fs-cta or lighter than Bold.
Don't set an inline prose link, a step number or a separator in red.
Don't spend noir wordplay on a plain title; name the page.
